summary: From the same front pose, obs_01 (left light) shows a thin vertical dark line at about x=0.47 and obs_02 (diffuse light) shows no such line, with the area continuous and evenly lit. Under MB-1 a vertical dark line that disappears when the light changes from the same pose is the fixture shadow, so no defect is recorded. MB-2 is not met because the line does not persist under a second light and neither observation shows a surface discontinuity. PROC-GEN-003 gives the same shadow-versus-surface reasoning. PROC-MB-002 concerns a hold-down clamp covering the bracket centre; no observation indicates a clamp occlusion here, since the target region was visible in both views, so it does not apply.
